Load packages

```{r}
#| output: false
#| warning: false

#Libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(gtsummary)
library(samplingbook)
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpattern)
library(forcats)
library(unibeCols)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(DataExplorer)
library(DescTools)
library(summarytools)
library(sf)
library(bfsMaps)
options(bfsMaps.base="C:/Program Files/R/bfsMaps/ThemaKart/2023_GEOM_TK")
library(mice)
library(survey)
library(srvyr)


# function for ggtext size

ggtext_size <- function(base_size, ratio = 1) {
  ratio * base_size / ggplot2::.pt
}


# function to round correctly

round2 = function(x, digits) {
  posneg = sign(x)
  z = abs(x)*10^digits
  z = z + 0.5 + sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)
  z = trunc(z)
  z = z/10^digits
  z*posneg
}

```


# Data preparation
## Import data


```{r}
#| warning: false
#| output: false

# survey
load(here("data", "processed", "pediatrician-survey_clean.RData"))

# FSO
data_canton_population <- read_excel(here("data", "raw", "canton_population.xlsx"))
data_canton_bip <- read_excel(here("data", "raw", "canton_bip.xlsx"))
data_gemeinde_population <- read_excel(here("data", "raw", "gemeinde_population.xlsx"))
data_gemeinde_urban <- read_excel(here("data", "raw", "gemeinde_urban.xlsx"))
data_canton_medical_diplomas <- read_excel(here("data", "raw", "canton_medical_diplomas.xlsx"))

# pediatricians FMH
data_FMH <- read_excel(here("data", "raw", "pediatricians_FMH.xlsx"))
data_FMH_age_sex_canton <- read_excel(here("data", "raw", "pediatricians_practice_FMH_by_age_sex_canton.xlsx"))

# pediatricians SGP
data_SGP <- read_excel(here("data", "raw", "pediatricians_SGP.xlsx"))

# Taxpunktwerte
data_taxpunkt <- read_excel(here("data", "raw", "taxpunkt.xlsx"))

```

## Inclusion and exclusion criteria

We sent an online survey to all board-certified members of the SSP.

Include
- all records with an answer on the first page

Exclude
- retired members
- non clinically active

```{r}
# answers
nrow(data |> filter(is.na(gender) & is.na(age) & is.na(place_work) & is.na(specialty)))

# drop record without any answer on the first page
data <- data |> 
  filter((is.na(gender) & is.na(age) & is.na(place_work) & is.na(specialty)) == FALSE)

n_total <- 1940
n_responders <- nrow(data)

response_rate_opened <- n_responders/n_total

# pensioned or not clinically active
data |> 
  select(place_work, retired) |> 
  tbl_summary()

data_pensioned_not_active <- data |> 
  filter(place_work == "Ich bin derzeit nicht klinisch tätig oder ich bin pensioniert")

rm(data_pensioned_not_active)

# drop records of pensioned or not clinically active pediatricians
data <- data |> 
  filter(place_work != "Ich bin derzeit nicht klinisch tätig oder ich bin pensioniert")

# response rates

n_clinically_active <- nrow(data)

n_complete <- nrow(data |> filter(physician_questionnaire_complete == "Complete"))

response_rate_clinically_active <- n_clinically_active/n_total
response_rate_complete <- n_complete/n_total

```


## Create variables

### Work setting

```{r}

data <- data |> 
  mutate(place_work = as.character(place_work)) |> 
  mutate(place_work = factor(place_work, levels = c("Praxis (Grundversorgung oder Spezialist:in)", "Spital", "Sowohl Spital als auch Praxis")))

```


### Specialisation

Define pediatric specialists as
- pediatrician (board-certified, FMH) +
-- pediatric specialty OR
-- additional FMH (not Allgemeine Innere Medizin)

```{r}

  mutate(specialization = case_when(specialty == "Pädiatrie (FMH Kinder- und Jugendmedizin)" &  specialty_additional_fmh___1 == "Checked"~ "No Specialization",
```

# Estimation of FTE


Number of practice pediatricians in Switzerland (by age, sex, canton) from FMH-Ärztestatistik 2024 [Hostettler und Kraft](https://www.fmh.ch/themen/aerztestatistik/fmh-aerztestatistik.cfm).

Population under 18 years (0-17) per canton in 2023 from [FSO](https://www.pxweb.bfs.admin.ch/pxweb/de/px-x-0102010000_102/px-x-0102010000_102/px-x-0102010000_102.px/).

Estimations
- average: pediatricians not part of survey --> workload avg. from survey (per canton)
- imputation: pediatricians not part of survey --> imputed workload based on age, sex, region
- conservative: pediatricians not part of survey --> workload 50%
- optimistic: pediatricians not part of survey --> workload 100%

Pediatricians of survey

```{r}

data_fte_estimation_survey <- data |> 
  filter(place_work == "Praxis (Grundversorgung oder Spezialist:in)" | place_work == "Sowohl Spital als auch Praxis") |>
  select(record_id, canton_practice, gender_complete, age_complete, working_percentage_practice)

data_pediatricians_survey <- data |> 
  filter(place_work == "Praxis (Grundversorgung oder Spezialist:in)" | place_work == "Sowohl Spital als auch Praxis") |>
  group_by(canton_practice, gender_complete, age_complete) |> 
  summarise(practice_pediatricians_survey = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(sex = as.character(gender_complete),
         age = as.character(age_complete),
         canton = canton_practice) |> 
  select(-c(canton_practice, gender_complete, age_complete))
  

```

Pediatricians not in survey

```{r}
data_pediatricians_total <- data_FMH_age_sex_canton |> 
  left_join(data_pediatricians_survey, by = c("canton", "sex", "age"))

data_pediatricians_total <- data_pediatricians_total |> 
  mutate(practice_pediatricians_survey = case_when(is.na(practice_pediatricians_survey) ~ 0,
                                                   TRUE ~ practice_pediatricians_survey),
         difference_fmh_survey = practice_pediatricians_fmh - practice_pediatricians_survey)

# manually correct possible discrepancies of age to not add too many pediatricians
data_pediatricians_total <- data_pediatricians_total |> 
  mutate(number_additional = case_when(difference_fmh_survey < 0 ~ 0,
                                       # Graubünden ~ 1 discrepancy: checked, correct
                                       # Jura ~ 1 discrepancy: checked, correct
                                       # Neuenburg ~ 2 discrepancies: checked, correct
                                       # Obwalden ~ 2 discrepancies: checked, correct
                                       # Solothurn ~ 3 discrepancies: checked, 1 correct,
                                       #                                      1 wrong age and sex (--> corrected in original dataset now)
                                       #                                      1 wrong sex (--> corrected in original dataset now), still discrepancy
                                       # St. Gallen ~ 1 discrepancy: checked, correct
                                       # Tessin ~ 2 discrepancies: checked, correct
                                       # Thurgau ~ 2 discrepancies: checked, 1 correct,
                                       #                                     1 wrong sex (--> corrected in original dataset now)
                                       # Uri ~ 2 discrepancies: checked, correct
                                       # Valais ~ 3 discrepancies: checked, correct
                                       TRUE ~ difference_fmh_survey))

data_fte_estimation_fmh <- data_pediatricians_total |> 
  filter(number_additional > 0) |> 
  select(age, canton, sex, number_additional) |> 
  uncount(number_additional) |> 
  mutate(source = "FMH",
         record_id = paste0("FMH-", row_number()))


```

combine fmh and survey

```{r}
data_fte_estimation <- data_fte_estimation_survey |> 
  mutate(record_id = as.character(record_id),
         source = "Survey",
         sex = gender_complete,
         age = age_complete,
         canton = case_when(canton_practice == "Freiburg" ~ "Fribourg",
                                 canton_practice == "Waadt" ~ "Vaud",
                                 canton_practice == "Wallis" ~ "Valais",
                                 canton_practice == "Neuenburg" ~ "Neuchâtel",
                                 canton_practice == "Genf" ~ "Genève",
                                 TRUE ~ as.character(canton_practice))) |> 
  select(record_id, source, canton, sex, age, working_percentage_practice) |> 
  bind_rows(data_fte_estimation_fmh) |> 
  mutate(grossregion = factor(case_when(canton == "Genève" | canton == "Vaud" | canton == "Valais" ~ "Région lémanique",
                                 canton == "Bern" | canton == "Solothurn" | canton == "Fribourg" | canton == "Neuchâtel" | canton == "Jura" ~ "Espace Mittelland",
                                 canton == "Basel-Stadt" | canton == "Basel-Landschaft" | canton == "Aargau" ~ "Nordwestschweiz",
                                 canton == "Zürich" ~ "Zürich",
                                 canton == "St. Gallen" | canton == "Thurgau" | canton == "Appenzell Innerrhoden" | canton == "Appenzell Ausserrhoden" | canton == "Glarus" | canton == "Schaffhausen" | canton == "Graubünden" ~ "Ostschweiz",
                                 canton == "Uri" | canton == "Schwyz" | canton == "Obwalden" | canton == "Nidwalden" | canton == "Luzern" | canton == "Zug" ~ "Zentralschweiz",
                                 canton == "Tessin" ~ "Ticino"))) |> 
  select(record_id, source, canton, grossregion, sex, age, working_percentage_practice)
  

```

##  Imputation working percentage

Average Canton

```{r}

data_fte_estimation <- data_fte_estimation |> 
  group_by(canton) |> 
  mutate(
    working_percentage_practice_canton_prediction = case_when(
      canton == "Appenzell Innerrhoden" ~ 75,
      TRUE ~ mean(working_percentage_practice, na.rm = TRUE)),
    working_percentage_practice_canton = case_when(
      is.na(working_percentage_practice) == FALSE ~ working_percentage_practice,
      canton == "Appenzell Innerrhoden" ~ 75,
      TRUE ~ mean(working_percentage_practice, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    working_percentage_practice_canton_residual = working_percentage_practice_canton_prediction - working_percentage_practice) |> 
  ungroup()

```

Average Grossregion

```{r}

data_fte_estimation <- data_fte_estimation |> 
  group_by(grossregion) |> 
  mutate(
    working_percentage_practice_grossregion_prediction = mean(working_percentage_practice, na.rm = TRUE),
    working_percentage_practice_grossregion = case_when(
      is.na(working_percentage_practice) == FALSE ~ working_percentage_practice,
      grossregion == "Appenzell Innerrhoden" ~ 75,
      TRUE ~ mean(working_percentage_practice, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    working_percentage_practice_grossregion_residual = working_percentage_practice_grossregion_prediction - working_percentage_practice) |> 
  ungroup()

```

Linear regression

```{r}

lm_model <- lm(working_percentage_practice ~ age + sex + grossregion, data = data_fte_estimation)

summary(lm_model)

data_fte_estimation <- data_fte_estimation |> 
  mutate(working_percentage_practice_lm = case_when(is.na(working_percentage_practice) == FALSE ~ working_percentage_practice,
                                                    TRUE ~ predict(lm_model, newdata = data_fte_estimation)),
         working_percentage_practice_lm_prediction = predict(lm_model, newdata = data_fte_estimation),
         working_percentage_practice_lm_residual = working_percentage_practice_lm_prediction - working_percentage_practice)

```

Mice

```{r}
set.seed(1000)

mice_imputed <- mice(data_fte_estimation |> select(age, sex, grossregion, working_percentage_practice),
                     method = "pmm",
                     m = 100,
                     maxit = 10,
                     seed = 1000)

plot(mice_imputed)

lm_mice_model <- with(mice_imputed, lm(working_percentage_practice ~ 1))

pool_results <- pool(lm_mice_model)
summary(pool_results)

mice_completed <- complete(mice_imputed, "long")

mean_imputed <- mice_completed |> 
  group_by(.id) |> 
  summarise(working_percentage_practice_mice = mean(working_percentage_practice, na.rm = TRUE))

data_fte_estimation <- data_fte_estimation |> 
  bind_cols(mean_imputed |> select(working_percentage_practice_mice, .id))
```

Aggregate cantonal average imputation with 95% CI

```{r}

fte_canton_canton <- data_fte_estimation |>
    group_by(canton) |>
    summarise(
      n_practice_pediatricians_fte = n(),
      n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage = sum(!is.na(working_percentage_practice)),
      total_population_0_13 = first(population_0_13),
      total_population_0_14 = first(population_0_14),
      total_population_0_15 = first(population_0_15),
      total_population_0_16 = first(population_0_16),
      total_population_0_17 = first(population_0_17),
      total_population_0_18 = first(population_0_18),
      total_population_0_19 = first(population_0_19),
      
      # Point estimates
      fte_survey = sum(working_percentage_practice/100, na.rm = TRUE),
      fte = sum(working_percentage_practice_canton/100),
      fte_per_1000_0_13 = (fte / total_population_0_13) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_14 = (fte / total_population_0_14) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_15 = (fte / total_population_0_15) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_16 = (fte / total_population_0_16) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_17 = (fte / total_population_0_17) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_18 = (fte / total_population_0_18) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_19 = (fte / total_population_0_19) * 1000,
      mean_working_percentage = mean(working_percentage_practice_canton, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # Uncertainty components
      variance_mean_working_percentage = var(working_percentage_practice, na.rm = TRUE)/n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage,
      variance_residuals_working_percentage = sum(working_percentage_practice_canton_residual^2, na.rm = TRUE)/n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage^2,
      total_variance_mean_working_percentage = variance_residuals_working_percentage + variance_mean_working_percentage,
      se = sqrt(total_variance_mean_working_percentage),
      
      fpc = sqrt((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage)/(n_practice_pediatricians_fte - 1)),
      
      mean_working_percentage_lower_95 = mean_working_percentage - qt(0.975, df = n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage-1)*se * fpc,
      mean_working_percentage_upper_95 = mean_working_percentage + qt(0.975, df = n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage-1)*se * fpc,
      
      mean_working_percentage_lower_pb = ifelse((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage) > 0, (fte_survey + 0)/n_practice_pediatricians_fte*100, mean_working_percentage),
      mean_working_percentage_upper_pb = ifelse((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage) > 0,(fte_survey + (n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage))/n_practice_pediatricians_fte*100, mean_working_percentage),
      
      mean_working_percentage_lower = ifelse(abs(mean_working_percentage_lower_pb - mean_working_percentage) < abs(mean_working_percentage_lower_95 - mean_working_percentage) | mean_working_percentage == "NaN"| mean_working_percentage_lower_95 == "NaN", mean_working_percentage_lower_pb, mean_working_percentage_lower_95),
      mean_working_percentage_upper = ifelse(abs(mean_working_percentage_upper_pb - mean_working_percentage) < abs(mean_working_percentage_upper_95 - mean_working_percentage) | mean_working_percentage == "NaN" | mean_working_percentage_upper_95 == "NaN", mean_working_percentage_upper_pb, mean_working_percentage_upper_95),
      
      # CIs for FTE
      fte_lower = sum(mean_working_percentage_lower/100*n_practice_pediatricians_fte),
      fte_upper = sum(mean_working_percentage_upper/100*n_practice_pediatricians_fte),
      
      # CIs for FTE per 1000
      fte_per_1000_0_13_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_13) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_13_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_13) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_14_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_14) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_14_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_14) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_15_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_15) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_15_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_15) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_16_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_16) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_16_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_16) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_17_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_17) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_17_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_17) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_18_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_18) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_18_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_18) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_19_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_19) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_19_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_19) * 1000,
      
      .groups = 'drop') |> 
  ungroup()
  
## Swiss results
```

Aggregate grossregion average imputation with 95% CI

```{r}

fte_grossregion_canton <- data_fte_estimation |>
    group_by(canton) |>
    summarise(
      n_practice_pediatricians_fte = n(),
      n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage = sum(!is.na(working_percentage_practice)),
      total_population_0_13 = first(population_0_13),
      total_population_0_14 = first(population_0_14),
      total_population_0_15 = first(population_0_15),
      total_population_0_16 = first(population_0_16),
      total_population_0_17 = first(population_0_17),
      total_population_0_18 = first(population_0_18),
      total_population_0_19 = first(population_0_19),
      
      # Point estimates
      fte_survey = sum(working_percentage_practice/100, na.rm = TRUE),
      fte = sum(working_percentage_practice_grossregion/100),
      fte_per_1000_0_13 = (fte / total_population_0_13) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_14 = (fte / total_population_0_14) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_15 = (fte / total_population_0_15) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_16 = (fte / total_population_0_16) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_17 = (fte / total_population_0_17) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_18 = (fte / total_population_0_18) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_19 = (fte / total_population_0_19) * 1000,
      mean_working_percentage = mean(working_percentage_practice_grossregion, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # Uncertainty components
      variance_mean_working_percentage = var(working_percentage_practice, na.rm = TRUE)/n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage,
      variance_residuals_working_percentage = sum(working_percentage_practice_grossregion_residual^2, na.rm = TRUE)/n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage^2,
      total_variance_mean_working_percentage = variance_residuals_working_percentage + variance_mean_working_percentage,
      se = sqrt(total_variance_mean_working_percentage),
      
      fpc = sqrt((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage)/(n_practice_pediatricians_fte - 1)),
      
      mean_working_percentage_lower_95 = mean_working_percentage - qt(0.975, df = n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage-1)*se * fpc,
      mean_working_percentage_upper_95 = mean_working_percentage + qt(0.975, df = n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage-1)*se * fpc,
      
      mean_working_percentage_lower_pb = ifelse((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage) > 0, (fte_survey + 0)/n_practice_pediatricians_fte*100, mean_working_percentage),
      mean_working_percentage_upper_pb = ifelse((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage) > 0,(fte_survey + (n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage))/n_practice_pediatricians_fte*100, mean_working_percentage),
      
      mean_working_percentage_lower = ifelse(abs(mean_working_percentage_lower_pb - mean_working_percentage) < abs(mean_working_percentage_lower_95 - mean_working_percentage) | mean_working_percentage == "NaN"| mean_working_percentage_lower_95 == "NaN", mean_working_percentage_lower_pb, mean_working_percentage_lower_95),
      mean_working_percentage_upper = ifelse(abs(mean_working_percentage_upper_pb - mean_working_percentage) < abs(mean_working_percentage_upper_95 - mean_working_percentage) | mean_working_percentage == "NaN" | mean_working_percentage_upper_95 == "NaN", mean_working_percentage_upper_pb, mean_working_percentage_upper_95),
      
      # CIs for FTE
      fte_lower = sum(mean_working_percentage_lower/100*n_practice_pediatricians_fte),
      fte_upper = sum(mean_working_percentage_upper/100*n_practice_pediatricians_fte),
      
      # CIs for FTE per 1000
      fte_per_1000_0_13_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_13) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_13_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_13) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_14_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_14) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_14_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_14) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_15_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_15) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_15_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_15) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_16_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_16) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_16_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_16) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_17_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_17) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_17_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_17) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_18_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_18) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_18_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_18) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_19_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_19) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_19_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_19) * 1000,
      
      .groups = 'drop') |> 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# For MICE we need special handling due to multiple imputations
m <- mice_imputed$m
n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage_swiss <- sum(is.na(data$working_percentage_practice)==FALSE)
fte_survey_swiss <- sum(data$working_percentage_practice/100, na.rm=TRUE)

# Canton-level calculations
fte_mice_canton <- mice_imputed |>
  complete("long") |> 
  left_join(data_fte_estimation |> 
              select(record_id, source, canton, .id, population_0_13, population_0_14, population_0_15, population_0_16, population_0_17, population_0_18, population_0_19, n_practice_pediatricians_survey, n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage, n_practice_pediatricians_FMH, fte_survey), 
            by = ".id") |> 
  group_by(.imp, canton) |> 
  summarise(
    n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage_imp = first(n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage),
    n_practice_pediatricians_fte_imp = n(),
    fte_survey_imp = first(fte_survey),
    mean_working_percentage_practice_imp = mean(working_percentage_practice, na.rm = TRUE),
    var_mean_working_percentage_practice_imp = var(working_percentage_practice, na.rm = TRUE)/n_practice_pediatricians_fte_imp,
    fte_imp = sum(working_percentage_practice/100),
    total_population_0_13_imp = sum(unique(population_0_13), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_population_0_14_imp = sum(unique(population_0_14), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_population_0_15_imp = sum(unique(population_0_15), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_population_0_16_imp = sum(unique(population_0_16), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_population_0_17_imp = sum(unique(population_0_17), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_population_0_18_imp = sum(unique(population_0_18), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_population_0_19_imp = sum(unique(population_0_19), na.rm = TRUE),
    fte_per_1000_0_13_imp = (fte_imp / total_population_0_13_imp) * 1000,
    fte_per_1000_0_14_imp = (fte_imp / total_population_0_14_imp) * 1000,
    fte_per_1000_0_15_imp = (fte_imp / total_population_0_15_imp) * 1000,
    fte_per_1000_0_16_imp = (fte_imp / total_population_0_16_imp) * 1000,
    fte_per_1000_0_17_imp = (fte_imp / total_population_0_17_imp) * 1000,
    fte_per_1000_0_18_imp = (fte_imp / total_population_0_18_imp) * 1000,
    fte_per_1000_0_19_imp = (fte_imp / total_population_0_19_imp) * 1000,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(canton) |> 
  summarise(
    n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage = first(n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage_imp),
    n_practice_pediatricians_fte = first(n_practice_pediatricians_fte_imp),
    fte_survey = first(fte_survey_imp),
    total_population_0_13 = first(total_population_0_13_imp),
    total_population_0_14 = first(total_population_0_14_imp),
    total_population_0_15 = first(total_population_0_15_imp),
    total_population_0_16 = first(total_population_0_16_imp),
    total_population_0_17 = first(total_population_0_17_imp),
    total_population_0_18 = first(total_population_0_18_imp),
    total_population_0_19 = first(total_population_0_19_imp),
    
    # Point estimates
    mean_working_percentage = mean(mean_working_percentage_practice_imp),
    fte = mean(fte_imp),
    fte_per_1000_0_13 = mean(fte_per_1000_0_13_imp),
    fte_per_1000_0_14 = mean(fte_per_1000_0_14_imp),
    fte_per_1000_0_15 = mean(fte_per_1000_0_15_imp),
    fte_per_1000_0_16 = mean(fte_per_1000_0_16_imp),
    fte_per_1000_0_17 = mean(fte_per_1000_0_17_imp),
    fte_per_1000_0_18 = mean(fte_per_1000_0_18_imp),
    fte_per_1000_0_19 = mean(fte_per_1000_0_19_imp),
    
    
    # working _percentage
    ## Variance components
    within_var_working_percentage = mean(var_mean_working_percentage_practice_imp),
    between_var_working_percentage = var(mean_working_percentage_practice_imp),
    total_var_working_percentage = within_var_working_percentage + between_var_working_percentage + (between_var_working_percentage/m),
    
    ## Degrees of freedom
    df_working_percentage_rubin = (m - 1) * (1 + (within_var_working_percentage / ((1 + 1/m) * between_var_working_percentage)))^2,
    df_working_percentage_obs = n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage - 1,
    df_working_percentage_adj = (1/df_working_percentage_rubin + 1/df_working_percentage_obs)^(-1),
    
    
    ## CIs
    mean_working_percentage_se = sqrt(total_var_working_percentage),
    fpc = sqrt((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage)/(n_practice_pediatricians_fte - 1)),
    
    mean_working_percentage_lower_95 = ifelse(total_var_working_percentage == 0 | df_working_percentage_adj == "NaN", mean_working_percentage, mean_working_percentage - qt(0.975, df_working_percentage_adj)*mean_working_percentage_se * fpc),
    mean_working_percentage_upper_95 = ifelse(total_var_working_percentage == 0 | df_working_percentage_adj == "NaN", mean_working_percentage, mean_working_percentage + qt(0.975, df_working_percentage_adj)*mean_working_percentage_se * fpc),
    
    mean_working_percentage_lower_pb = ifelse((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage) > 0, (fte_survey + 0)/n_practice_pediatricians_fte*100, mean_working_percentage),
      mean_working_percentage_upper_pb = ifelse((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage) > 0,(fte_survey + (n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage))/n_practice_pediatricians_fte*100, mean_working_percentage),
      
      mean_working_percentage_lower = ifelse(abs(mean_working_percentage_lower_pb - mean_working_percentage) < abs(mean_working_percentage_lower_95 - mean_working_percentage) | mean_working_percentage == "NaN"| mean_working_percentage_lower_95 == "NaN", mean_working_percentage_lower_pb, mean_working_percentage_lower_95),
      mean_working_percentage_upper = ifelse(abs(mean_working_percentage_upper_pb - mean_working_percentage) < abs(mean_working_percentage_upper_95 - mean_working_percentage) | mean_working_percentage == "NaN" | mean_working_percentage_upper_95 == "NaN", mean_working_percentage_upper_pb, mean_working_percentage_upper_95),

      # CIs for FTE
      fte_lower = sum(mean_working_percentage_lower/100*n_practice_pediatricians_fte),
      fte_upper = sum(mean_working_percentage_upper/100*n_practice_pediatricians_fte),
      # CIs for FTE per 1000
      fte_per_1000_0_13_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_13) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_13_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_13) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_14_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_14) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_14_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_14) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_15_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_15) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_15_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_15) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_16_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_16) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_16_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_16) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_17_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_17) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_17_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_17) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_18_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_18) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_18_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_18) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_19_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_19) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_19_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_19) * 1000
    )

# Swiss-level calculations
fte_mice_swiss <- mice_imputed |>

    # working _percentage

    total_var_working_percentage = within_var_working_percentage + between_var_working_percentage + (between_var_working_percentage/m),
```

```{r}
data_fte_canton <- data_fte_estimation |>

      n_practice_pediatricians_fte = n(),

      se = sqrt(variance_mean_working_percentage_practice_survey),

      mean_working_percentage_survey_upper_pb = ifelse((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage) > 0,(fte_survey + (n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage))/n_practice_pediatricians_fte*100, mean_working_percentage_survey),
      
      mean_working_percentage_survey_lower = ifelse(abs(mean_working_percentage_survey_lower_pb - mean_working_percentage_survey) < abs(mean_working_percentage_survey_lower_95 - mean_working_percentage_survey) | mean_working_percentage_survey == "NaN", mean_working_percentage_survey_lower_pb, mean_working_percentage_survey_lower_95),
      mean_working_percentage_survey_upper = ifelse(abs(mean_working_percentage_survey_upper_pb - mean_working_percentage_survey) < abs(mean_working_percentage_survey_upper_95 - mean_working_percentage_survey) | mean_working_percentage_survey == "NaN", mean_working_percentage_survey_upper_pb, mean_working_percentage_survey_upper_95))
```

```{r}
              mutate(fte_canton_avg = paste0(trimws(format(round2(fte,digits =0),nsmall=0))," (",trimws(format(round2(fte_lower,digits =0),nsmall=0)),"-", trimws(format(round2(fte_upper,digits =0),nsmall=0)),")"),
                     fte_per_1000_0_17_canton_avg = paste0(trimws(format(round2(fte_per_1000_0_17,digits =2),nsmall=2))," (",trimws(format(round2(fte_per_1000_0_17_lower,digits =2),nsmall=2)),"-", trimws(format(round2(fte_per_1000_0_17_upper,digits =2),nsmall=2)),")")) |> 
              select(canton, fte_canton_avg, fte_per_1000_0_17_canton_avg), by = "canton") |> 
  left_join(fte_grossregion |> 
              mutate(fte_grossregion_avg = paste0(trimws(format(round2(fte,digits =0),nsmall=0)), " (", trimws(format(round2(fte_lower,digits =0),nsmall=0)), "-", trimws(format(round2(fte_upper,digits =0),nsmall=0)), ")"),
                     fte_per_1000_0_17_grossregion_avg = paste0(trimws(format(round2(fte_per_1000_0_17,digits =2),nsmall=2)), " (", trimws(format(round2(fte_per_1000_0_17_lower,digits =2),nsmall=2)), "-", trimws(format(round2(fte_per_1000_0_17_upper,digits =2),nsmall=2)), ")")) |> 
              select(canton, fte_grossregion_avg, fte_per_1000_0_17_grossregion_avg), by = "canton") |> 
  left_join(fte_lm |> 
              mutate(fte_lm = paste0(trimws(format(round2(fte,digits =0),nsmall=0)), " (", trimws(format(round2(fte_lower,digits =0),nsmall=0)), "-", trimws(format(round2(fte_upper,digits =0),nsmall=0)), ")"),
                     fte_per_1000_0_17_lm = paste0(trimws(format(round2(fte_per_1000_0_17,digits =2),nsmall=2)), " (", trimws(format(round2(fte_per_1000_0_17_lower,digits =2),nsmall=2)), "-", trimws(format(round2(fte_per_1000_0_17_upper,digits =2),nsmall=2)), ")")) |> 
              select(canton, fte_lm, fte_per_1000_0_17_lm), by = "canton") |> 
  left_join(fte_mice |> 
              mutate(fte_mice = paste0(trimws(format(round2(fte,digits =0),nsmall=0)), " (", trimws(format(round2(fte_lower,digits =0),nsmall=0)), "-", trimws(format(round2(fte_upper,digits =0),nsmall=0)), ")"),
                     fte_per_1000_0_17_mice = paste0(trimws(format(round2(fte_per_1000_0_17,digits =2),nsmall=2)), " (", trimws(format(round2(fte_per_1000_0_17_lower,digits =2),nsmall=2)), "-", trimws(format(round2(fte_per_1000_0_17_upper,digits =2),nsmall=2)), ")")) |> 
              select(canton, fte_mice, fte_per_1000_0_17_mice), by = "canton") |> 
  left_join(fte_cons_opt |> 
              mutate(fte_conservative = trimws(format(round2(fte_conservative,digits = 0),nsmall=0)),
                     fte_optimistic = trimws(format(round2(fte_optimistic, digits = 0),nsmall=0)),
                     fte_per_1000_0_17_conservative = trimws(format(round2(fte_per_1000_0_17_conservative,2),nsmall=2)),
                     fte_per_1000_0_17_optimistic = trimws(format(round2(fte_per_1000_0_17_optimistic,2),nsmall=2))) |> 
              select(canton, fte_conservative, fte_optimistic, fte_per_1000_0_17_conservative, fte_per_1000_0_17_optimistic), by = "canton") |> 
  left_join(data_canton_population |> select(canton, population_0_17), by = "canton") |> 
  select(canton, canton_short, n_practice_pediatricians_survey, n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage, n_practice_pediatricians_SGP, n_practice_pediatricians_FMH, n_practice_pediatricians_fte, working_percentage_survey, fte_canton_avg, fte_grossregion_avg, fte_lm, fte_mice, fte_conservative, fte_optimistic, population_0_17, fte_per_1000_0_17_canton_avg, fte_per_1000_0_17_grossregion_avg, fte_per_1000_0_17_lm, fte_per_1000_0_17_mice, fte_per_1000_0_17_conservative, fte_per_1000_0_17_optimistic)
```

```{r}
plot_fte_cantons_18 <- ggplot(data = map_cantons_sf) +
  geom_sf(data = lakes_sf, fill = "lightblue", color = NA )+
  geom_sf(aes(fill = fte_per_1000_0_17), color = "black")+
  scale_fill_viridis(
    option = "viridis",
    direction = 1,
    limits = c(0, 1.6),
    rescaler = function(x, to = c(0, 1), from = NULL) {
    ifelse(x<0.25,
           0,
           ifelse(x<1,
                  scales::rescale(x,
                                  to = to,
                                  from = c(0.25, 1)),
                  1)
           )
      }) +
  geom_text_repel(mapping = aes(x = ifelse(name == "Basel-Stadt", X - 5000 ,
                                    ifelse(name == "Vaud", X - 15000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Fribourg", X + 4000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Aargau", X + 3000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Jura", X + 3000, X))))),
                                y = ifelse(name == "Basel-Stadt", Y + 8000 ,
                                    ifelse(name == "Obwalden", Y - 3000,
                                    ifelse(name == "St. Gallen", Y - 4000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Schaffhausen", Y + 2000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Fribourg", Y + 8000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Zürich", Y + 4000, Y)))))), label = format(round(fte_per_1000_0_17, 2),nsmall = 2)), bg.color = "black", bg.r = 0.1, size = ggtext_size(8), color = "white", force = 0.001, force_pull = 10000)+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(fill = "Estimated FTE primary care pediatricians per 1000 children")+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 8, colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 8, colour = "black"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(l=0, b=0, r=0, t=-0.5, unit = "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    plot.margin = margin(l=0, b=0, r=0, t=0, unit = "cm")) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5))

plot_fte_cantons_18
```

### Supplement-Figure 4A: Estimation of FTEs by Grossregion

Aggregate Mice imputation method with 95% CI

```{r}

data_fte_estimation_grossregion <- data_fte_estimation |> 
  select(record_id, .id, source, sex, age, canton, grossregion, working_percentage_practice) |> 
left_join(data_fte_estimation |> 
    mutate(grossregion = factor(case_when(canton == "Genève" | canton == "Vaud" | canton == "Valais" ~ "Région lémanique",
                                 canton == "Bern" | canton == "Solothurn" | canton == "Fribourg" | canton == "Neuchâtel" | canton == "Jura" ~ "Espace Mittelland",
                                 canton == "Basel-Stadt" | canton == "Basel-Landschaft" | canton == "Aargau" ~ "Nordwestschweiz",
                                 canton == "Zürich" ~ "Zürich",
                                 canton == "St. Gallen" | canton == "Thurgau" | canton == "Appenzell Innerrhoden" | canton == "Appenzell Ausserrhoden" | canton == "Glarus" | canton == "Schaffhausen" | canton == "Graubünden" ~ "Ostschweiz",
                                 canton == "Uri" | canton == "Schwyz" | canton == "Obwalden" | canton == "Nidwalden" | canton == "Luzern" | canton == "Zug" ~ "Zentralschweiz",
                                 canton == "Tessin" ~ "Ticino"))) |> 
  group_by(canton) |> 
  slice(1) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(grossregion) |> 
  summarise(population_0_15 = sum(population_0_15),
            population_0_17 = sum(population_0_17),
            n_practice_pediatricians_survey = sum(n_practice_pediatricians_survey),
            n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage = sum(n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage),
            n_practice_pediatricians_FMH = sum(n_practice_pediatricians_FMH),
            fte_survey = sum(fte_survey)) |> 
  ungroup(), by = "grossregion")
  

# For MICE we need special handling due to multiple imputations
m <- mice_imputed$m
n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage_swiss <- sum(is.na(data$working_percentage_practice)==FALSE)
fte_survey_swiss <- sum(data$working_percentage_practice/100, na.rm=TRUE)

# Grossregion-level calculations
fte_mice_grossregion_estimation <- mice_imputed |>
  complete("long") |> 
  left_join(data_fte_estimation_grossregion |> 
              select(record_id, source, .id, population_0_15, population_0_17, n_practice_pediatricians_survey, n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage, n_practice_pediatricians_FMH, fte_survey), 
            by = ".id") |> 
  group_by(.imp, grossregion) |> 
  summarise(
    n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage_imp = first(n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage),
    n_practice_pediatricians_fte_imp = n(),
    fte_survey_imp = first(fte_survey),
    mean_working_percentage_practice_imp = mean(working_percentage_practice, na.rm = TRUE),
    var_mean_working_percentage_practice_imp = var(working_percentage_practice, na.rm = TRUE)/n_practice_pediatricians_fte_imp,
    fte_imp = sum(working_percentage_practice/100),
    total_population_0_15_imp = sum(unique(population_0_15), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_population_0_17_imp = sum(unique(population_0_17), na.rm = TRUE),
    fte_per_1000_0_15_imp = (fte_imp / total_population_0_15_imp) * 1000,
    fte_per_1000_0_17_imp = (fte_imp / total_population_0_17_imp) * 1000,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(grossregion) |> 
  summarise(
    n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage = first(n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage_imp),
    n_practice_pediatricians_fte = first(n_practice_pediatricians_fte_imp),
    fte_survey = first(fte_survey_imp),
    total_population_0_15 = first(total_population_0_15_imp),
    total_population_0_17 = first(total_population_0_17_imp),
    
    # Point estimates
    mean_working_percentage = mean(mean_working_percentage_practice_imp),
    fte = mean(fte_imp),
    fte_per_1000_0_15 = mean(fte_per_1000_0_15_imp),
    fte_per_1000_0_17 = mean(fte_per_1000_0_17_imp),
    
    
    # working _percentage
    ## Variance components
    within_var_working_percentage = mean(var_mean_working_percentage_practice_imp),
    between_var_working_percentage = var(mean_working_percentage_practice_imp),
    total_var_working_percentage = within_var_working_percentage + between_var_working_percentage + (between_var_working_percentage/m),
    
    ## Degrees of freedom
    df_working_percentage_rubin = (m - 1) * (1 + (within_var_working_percentage / ((1 + 1/m) * between_var_working_percentage)))^2,
    df_working_percentage_obs = n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage - 1,
    df_working_percentage_adj = (1/df_working_percentage_rubin + 1/df_working_percentage_obs)^(-1),
    
    
    ## CIs
    mean_working_percentage_se = sqrt(total_var_working_percentage),
    fpc = sqrt((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage)/(n_practice_pediatricians_fte - 1)),
    
    mean_working_percentage_lower_95 = ifelse(total_var_working_percentage == 0 | df_working_percentage_adj == "NaN", mean_working_percentage, mean_working_percentage - qt(0.975, df_working_percentage_adj)*mean_working_percentage_se * fpc),
    mean_working_percentage_upper_95 = ifelse(total_var_working_percentage == 0 | df_working_percentage_adj == "NaN", mean_working_percentage, mean_working_percentage + qt(0.975, df_working_percentage_adj)*mean_working_percentage_se * fpc),
    
    mean_working_percentage_lower_pb = ifelse((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage) > 0, (fte_survey + 0)/n_practice_pediatricians_fte*100, mean_working_percentage),
      mean_working_percentage_upper_pb = ifelse((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage) > 0,(fte_survey + (n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage))/n_practice_pediatricians_fte*100, mean_working_percentage),
      
      mean_working_percentage_lower = ifelse(abs(mean_working_percentage_lower_pb - mean_working_percentage) < abs(mean_working_percentage_lower_95 - mean_working_percentage) | mean_working_percentage == "NaN"| mean_working_percentage_lower_95 == "NaN", mean_working_percentage_lower_pb, mean_working_percentage_lower_95),
      mean_working_percentage_upper = ifelse(abs(mean_working_percentage_upper_pb - mean_working_percentage) < abs(mean_working_percentage_upper_95 - mean_working_percentage) | mean_working_percentage == "NaN" | mean_working_percentage_upper_95 == "NaN", mean_working_percentage_upper_pb, mean_working_percentage_upper_95),

      # CIs for FTE
      fte_lower = sum(mean_working_percentage_lower/100*n_practice_pediatricians_fte),
      fte_upper = sum(mean_working_percentage_upper/100*n_practice_pediatricians_fte),
      # CIs for FTE per 1000
      fte_per_1000_0_15_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_15) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_15_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_15) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_17_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_17) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_17_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_17) * 1000)

# Swiss-level calculations
fte_mice_swiss_grossregion_estimation <- mice_imputed |>
  complete("long") |> 
  left_join(data_fte_estimation_grossregion |> 
              select(record_id, source, .id, population_0_15, population_0_17, n_practice_pediatricians_survey, n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage, n_practice_pediatricians_FMH), 
            by = ".id") |> 
  group_by(.imp) |> 
  summarise(
    n_practice_pediatricians_fte_imp = n(),
    mean_working_percentage_practice_imp = mean(working_percentage_practice, na.rm = TRUE),
    var_mean_working_percentage_practice_imp = var(working_percentage_practice, na.rm = TRUE)/n_practice_pediatricians_fte_imp,
    fte_imp = sum(working_percentage_practice/100),
    total_population_0_15_imp = sum(unique(population_0_15), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_population_0_17_imp = sum(unique(population_0_17), na.rm = TRUE),
    fte_per_1000_0_15_imp = (fte_imp / total_population_0_15_imp) * 1000,
    fte_per_1000_0_17_imp = (fte_imp / total_population_0_17_imp) * 1000,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  summarise(
    n_practice_pediatricians_fte = first(n_practice_pediatricians_fte_imp),
    total_population_0_15 = first(total_population_0_15_imp),
    total_population_0_17 = first(total_population_0_17_imp),
    # Point estimates
    fte = mean(fte_imp),
    fte_per_1000_0_15 = mean(fte_per_1000_0_15_imp),
    fte_per_1000_0_17 = mean(fte_per_1000_0_17_imp),
    mean_working_percentage = mean(mean_working_percentage_practice_imp),
    
    # working _percentage
    ## Variance components
    within_var_working_percentage = mean(var_mean_working_percentage_practice_imp),
    between_var_working_percentage = var(mean_working_percentage_practice_imp),
    total_var_working_percentage = within_var_working_percentage + between_var_working_percentage + (between_var_working_percentage/m),
    
    ## Degrees of freedom
    df_working_percentage_rubin = (m - 1) * (1 + (within_var_working_percentage / ((1 + 1/m) * between_var_working_percentage)))^2,
    df_working_percentage_obs = n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage_swiss - 1,
    df_working_percentage_adj = (1/df_working_percentage_rubin + 1/df_working_percentage_obs)^(-1),
    
    ## CIs
    mean_working_percentage_se = sqrt(total_var_working_percentage),
    fpc = sqrt((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage_swiss)/(n_practice_pediatricians_fte - 1)),

    mean_working_percentage_lower_95 = ifelse(total_var_working_percentage == 0 | df_working_percentage_adj == "NaN", mean_working_percentage, mean_working_percentage - qt(0.975, df_working_percentage_adj)*mean_working_percentage_se * fpc),
    mean_working_percentage_upper_95 = ifelse(total_var_working_percentage == 0 | df_working_percentage_adj == "NaN", mean_working_percentage, mean_working_percentage + qt(0.975, df_working_percentage_adj)*mean_working_percentage_se * fpc),
    
    mean_working_percentage_lower_pb = ifelse((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage_swiss) > 0, (fte_survey_swiss + 0)/n_practice_pediatricians_fte*100, mean_working_percentage),
      mean_working_percentage_upper_pb = ifelse((n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage_swiss) > 0,(fte_survey_swiss + (n_practice_pediatricians_fte - n_practice_pediatricians_working_percentage_swiss))/n_practice_pediatricians_fte*100, mean_working_percentage),
      
      mean_working_percentage_lower = ifelse(abs(mean_working_percentage_lower_pb - mean_working_percentage) < abs(mean_working_percentage_lower_95 - mean_working_percentage) | mean_working_percentage == "NaN"| mean_working_percentage_lower_95 == "NaN", mean_working_percentage_lower_pb, mean_working_percentage_lower_95),
      mean_working_percentage_upper = ifelse(abs(mean_working_percentage_upper_pb - mean_working_percentage) < abs(mean_working_percentage_upper_95 - mean_working_percentage) | mean_working_percentage == "NaN" | mean_working_percentage_upper_95 == "NaN", mean_working_percentage_upper_pb, mean_working_percentage_upper_95),
    
      # CIs for FTE
      fte_lower = sum(mean_working_percentage_lower/100*n_practice_pediatricians_fte),
      fte_upper = sum(mean_working_percentage_upper/100*n_practice_pediatricians_fte),
      # CIs for FTE per 1000
      fte_per_1000_0_15_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_15) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_15_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_15) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_17_lower = (fte_lower / total_population_0_17) * 1000,
      fte_per_1000_0_17_upper = (fte_upper / total_population_0_17) * 1000) |> 
  mutate(grossregion = "Schweiz")
```

```{r}
                                    ifelse(name == "Zentralschweiz", X + 2000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Ostschweiz", X + 5000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Nordwestschweiz", X + 10000, X)))),
                                y = ifelse(name == "Région lémanique", Y - 15000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Zentralschweiz", Y - 5000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Ostschweiz", Y - 15000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Nordwestschweiz", Y + 4000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Zürich", Y + 3000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Ticino", Y + 4000, Y)))))), label = format(round(fte_per_1000_0_17, 2),nsmall = 2)), bg.color = "black", bg.r = 0.1, size = ggtext_size(11), color = "white", force = 0.001, force_pull = 10000)+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(fill = "Estimated FTE primary care pediatricians per 1000 children (<18 years)")+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 11, colour = "black"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(l=0, b=0, r=0, t=-0.5, unit = "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    plot.margin = margin(l=0, b=0, r=0, t=0, unit = "cm")) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5))
```

## Categorize cantons by supply density

```{r}

fte_mice_canton <- fte_mice_canton |> 
  mutate(fte_category_16 = case_when(fte_per_1000_0_15 > 0.95 ~ ">0.95",
                                     fte_per_1000_0_15 > 0.55 ~ "0.55-0.95",
                                     fte_per_1000_0_15 <= 0.55 ~ "<=0.55"),
         fte_category_18 = case_when(fte_per_1000_0_17 > 0.83 ~ ">0.83",
                                     fte_per_1000_0_17 >= 0.50 ~ "0.50-0.83",
                                     fte_per_1000_0_17 < 0.50 ~ "<0.50"))

fte_mice_canton |> select(fte_category_16, fte_category_18) |> tbl_summary()

data <- data |> 
  left_join(fte_mice_canton |> select(canton, fte_per_1000_0_15, fte_per_1000_0_18, fte_category_16, fte_category_18), by = c("canton_work" = "canton")) |> 
  mutate(fte_category_16 = factor(fte_category_16, levels = c("<=0.55", "0.55-0.95", ">0.95")),
         fte_category_18 = factor(fte_category_18, levels = c("<0.50", "0.50-0.83", ">0.83")))


data |> select(fte_category_16, fte_category_18, place_work) |> tbl_summary(by = place_work) |> add_overall()

```

## Supplement-Table 4: Perceived shortage by canton

```{r}

data |> 
  select(shortage_pediatric_primary_care, canton_work) |> 
  tbl_summary(by=canton_work) |> 
  add_overall()

svy_data <- data |> 
  left_join(data_FMH |> select(canton, n_total_pediatricians_FMH), by = c("canton_work" = "canton")) |> 
  mutate(n_pop = case_when(canton_work == "Obwalden" ~ 3,
                           TRUE ~ n_total_pediatricians_FMH))

svydesign(
    id = ~1,
    fpc = ~n_pop,
    data = svy_data,
    strata = ~canton_work,
  ) |> 
  as_survey() |> 
  select(shortage_pediatric_primary_care, canton_work) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  tbl_svysummary(
    by = "canton_work",
    missing = "always",
    digits = list(everything() ~ 0),
    statistic = all_continuous() ~ "{median} [{p25}, {p75}]",
    missing_stat = "{N_miss} ({p_miss})"
    ) |> 
  add_ci(method = list(all_categorical() ~ "svyprop",
                       all_continuous() ~ "svymedian.mean"),
         style_fun = list(all_categorical() ~ label_style_sigfig(digits = 0, scale = 100),
                          all_continuous() ~ label_style_sigfig(digits = 0)))

data |> 
  filter(place_work == "Praxis (Grundversorgung oder Spezialist:in)" | place_work == "Sowohl Spital als auch Praxis") |>
  select(shortage_pediatric_primary_care, canton_work) |> 
  tbl_summary(by=canton_work) |> 
  add_overall()

data_shortage_canton <- data |>
  select(canton_work, shortage_pediatric_primary_care) |>
  drop_na() |>
  mutate(shortage_pediatric_primary_care = case_when(
    shortage_pediatric_primary_care == "Ich bin mir nicht sicher." ~ "Idk",
    TRUE ~ as.character(shortage_pediatric_primary_care)
  )) |>
  group_by(canton_work, shortage_pediatric_primary_care) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")


data_shortage_canton <- data_shortage_canton |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = shortage_pediatric_primary_care,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = list(count = 0)
  )

data_shortage_canton <- data_shortage_canton |> 
  full_join(data_FMH, by = c("canton_work" = "canton")) |> 
  mutate(Ja = case_when(canton_work == "Schweiz" ~ sum(data_shortage_canton$Ja),
                        canton_work == "Appenzell Innerrhoden" ~ NA,
                        TRUE ~ Ja),
         Nein = case_when(canton_work == "Schweiz" ~ sum(data_shortage_canton$Nein),
                        canton_work == "Appenzell Innerrhoden" ~ NA,
                        TRUE ~ Nein),
         Idk = case_when(canton_work == "Schweiz" ~ sum(data_shortage_canton$Idk),
                        canton_work == "Appenzell Innerrhoden" ~ NA,
                        TRUE ~ Idk))

data_shortage_canton <- data_shortage_canton |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    total_responses = sum(c_across(c(Ja, Nein, Idk))),
    yes_proportion = Ja / total_responses,
    no_proportion = Nein / total_responses,
    idk_proportion = Idk / total_responses) |> 
  ungroup()

data_shortage_canton <- data_shortage_canton |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(
    yes_lower = ifelse(total_responses >= n_total_pediatricians_FMH | is.na(Ja), NA, Sprop(m = Ja, n = total_responses, N = n_total_pediatricians_FMH)[[4]]$exact[1]),
    yes_upper = ifelse(total_responses >= n_total_pediatricians_FMH | is.na(Ja), NA, Sprop(m = Ja, n = total_responses, N = n_total_pediatricians_FMH)[[4]]$exact[2])) |>
  ungroup()

data_shortage_canton <- data_shortage_canton |> 
  mutate(canton_work = case_when(canton_work == "Freiburg" ~ "Fribourg",
                                 canton_work == "Waadt" ~ "Vaud",
                                 canton_work == "Wallis" ~ "Valais",
                                 canton_work == "Neuenburg" ~ "Neuchâtel",
                                 canton_work == "Genf" ~ "Genève",
                                 TRUE ~ canton_work))

```

## Alternative Table: Perceived shortage by urbanization

```{r}

data |> 
  filter(place_work == "Praxis (Grundversorgung oder Spezialist:in)" | place_work == "Sowohl Spital als auch Praxis") |>
  select(shortage_pediatric_primary_care, age_limit_pediatric_care, accepting_new_patients, accepting_emergency_patients, urbanization) |> 
  mutate(shortage_pediatric_primary_care = factor(shortage_pediatric_primary_care) |> forcats::fct_explicit_na(),
         age_limit_pediatric_care = factor(age_limit_pediatric_care) |> forcats::fct_explicit_na(),
         accepting_new_patients = factor(accepting_new_patients) |> forcats::fct_explicit_na(),
         accepting_emergency_patients = factor(accepting_emergency_patients) |> forcats::fct_explicit_na()) |>   
  tbl_summary(by = urbanization,
              digits = list(everything() ~ 0),
              statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p})",
              missing = "always",
              missing_stat = "{N_miss} ({p_miss})") |> 
  add_overall()


n_urban <- data |> filter(urbanization == "Städtische Gemeinde") |> nrow()
n_agglomeration <- data |> filter(urbanization == "Gemeinde in der Agglomeration einer Stadt") |> nrow()
n_rural <- data |> filter(urbanization == "Ländliche Gemeinde") |> nrow()

```

## Figure 1B: Perceived shortage across cantons


```{r}

map_cantons_sf <- GetMap("kant.map") |> 
  st_as_sf()


lakes_sf <- GetMap("see1.map") |> 
  st_as_sf()


map_cantons_sf <- map_cantons_sf |>
  left_join(data_shortage_canton, by = c("name" = "canton_work")) |> 
  bind_cols(st_coordinates(st_centroid(map_cantons_sf)))

plot_shortage_cantons <- ggplot(data = map_cantons_sf) +
  geom_sf(data = lakes_sf, fill = "lightblue", color = NA )+
  geom_sf(aes(fill = yes_proportion), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_viridis(direction = -1, breaks = 0.25*0:4, labels = percent(0.25*0:4), limits = c(0,1), option = "plasma")+
  geom_text_repel(mapping = aes(x = ifelse(name == "Basel-Stadt", X - 5000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Jura", X + 3000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Vaud", X - 5000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Fribourg", X + 5000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Aargau", X + 3000, X))))),
                                y = ifelse(name == "Basel-Stadt", Y + 8000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Vaud", Y + 2000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Fribourg", Y + 7000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Obwalden", Y - 2500,
                                    ifelse(name == "Zürich", Y + 2000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Glarus", Y - 2000,
                                    ifelse(name == "St. Gallen", Y - 3000, Y))))))), label = ifelse(is.na(yes_proportion), "NA", paste0(round(yes_proportion*100, 0), "%"))), bg.color = "black", bg.r = 0.1, size = ggtext_size(8), color = "white", force = 0.001, force_pull = 10000)+
  labs(fill = "Pediatricians (%) perceiving a shortage of pediatric primary care")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 8, colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 8, colour = "black"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(l=0, b=0, r=0, t=-0.5, unit = "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    plot.margin = margin(l=0, b=0, r=0, t=0, unit = "cm")) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5))

plot_shortage_cantons

ggsave(filename=file.path(here("output","figures","plot_shortage_cantons.svg")),plot_shortage_cantons,device=svg,units="cm", height=20, width=18)



plot_shortage_cantons_correlation_map <- ggplot(data = map_cantons_sf) +
  geom_sf(data = lakes_sf, fill = "lightblue", color = NA )+
  geom_sf(aes(fill = yes_proportion), color = "black")+
  scale_fill_viridis(direction = -1, breaks = 0.25*0:4, labels = percent(0.25*0:4), limits = c(0,1), option = "plasma")+
  geom_text_repel(mapping = aes(x = ifelse(name == "Basel-Stadt", X - 5000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Jura", X + 3000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Vaud", X - 5000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Fribourg", X + 5000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Aargau", X + 3000, X))))),
                                y = ifelse(name == "Basel-Stadt", Y + 8000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Vaud", Y + 2000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Fribourg", Y + 7000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Obwalden", Y - 2500,
                                    ifelse(name == "Zürich", Y + 2000,
                                    ifelse(name == "St. Gallen", Y - 3000, Y)))))), label = ifelse(is.na(yes_proportion), "NA", paste0(round(yes_proportion*100, 0), "%"))), bg.color = "black", bg.r = 0.1, size = ggtext_size(6), color = "white", force = 0.001, force_pull = 10000)+
  theme_minimal()+
  ggtitle("B: Pediatricians (%) perceiving a shortage")+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 6),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "cm"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(l=0, b=0, r=0, t=0, unit = "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(l=0, r=0, b=0, t=0, unit = "cm"))

```



### Supplement-Figure 4B: Perceived shortage across regions


```{r}

data |> 
  select(shortage_pediatric_primary_care, grossregion) |> 
  tbl_summary(by=grossregion) |> 
  add_overall()


data_shortage_grossregtion <- data |>
  select(grossregion, shortage_pediatric_primary_care) |>
  na.omit() |>
  mutate(shortage_pediatric_primary_care = case_when(
    shortage_pediatric_primary_care == "Ich bin mir nicht sicher." ~ "Idk",
    TRUE ~ as.character(shortage_pediatric_primary_care)
  )) |>
  group_by(grossregion, shortage_pediatric_primary_care) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")


data_shortage_grossregtion <- data_shortage_grossregtion |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = shortage_pediatric_primary_care,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = list(count = 0)
  )

data_shortage_grossregtion <- data_shortage_grossregtion |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    total_responses = sum(c_across(c(Ja, Nein, Idk))),
    yes_proportion = Ja / total_responses,
    no_proportion = Nein / total_responses,
    idk_proportion = Idk / total_responses
  ) |>
  ungroup()


map_grossregion_sf <- GetMap("greg.map") |> 
  st_as_sf()


lakes_sf <- GetMap("see1.map") |> 
  st_as_sf()


map_grossregion_sf <- map_grossregion_sf |>
  left_join(data_shortage_grossregtion, by = c("name" = "grossregion")) |> 
  bind_cols(st_coordinates(st_centroid(map_grossregion_sf)))

plot_shortage_grossregion <- ggplot(data = map_grossregion_sf) +
  geom_sf(data = lakes_sf, fill = "lightblue", color = NA )+
  geom_sf(aes(fill = yes_proportion), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_viridis(direction = -1, breaks = 0.25*0:4, labels = percent(0.25*0:4), limits = c(0,1), option = "plasma")+
  geom_text_repel(mapping = aes(x = ifelse(name == "Région lémanique", X + 15000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Zentralschweiz", X + 2000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Ostschweiz", X + 5000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Nordwestschweiz", X + 10000, X)))),
                                y = ifelse(name == "Région lémanique", Y - 15000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Zentralschweiz", Y - 5000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Ostschweiz", Y - 15000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Nordwestschweiz", Y + 4000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Zürich", Y + 3000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Ticino", Y + 4000, Y)))))), label = ifelse(is.na(yes_proportion), "NA", paste0(round(yes_proportion*100, 0), "%"))), bg.color = "black", bg.r = 0.1, size = ggtext_size(11), color = "white", force = 0.001, force_pull = 10000)+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(fill = "Pediatricians (%) perceiving a shortage of pediatric primary care")+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 11, colour = "black"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(l=0, b=0, r=0, t=-0.5, unit = "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    plot.margin = margin(l=0, b=0, r=0, t=0, unit = "cm")) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5))

plot_shortage_grossregion

ggsave(filename=file.path(here("output","figures","plot_shortage_grossregion.svg")),plot_shortage_grossregion,device=svg,units="cm", height=14, width=16, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
format_pvalue <- function(x) {

}

  select(place_work, working_percentage, working_percentage_group, part_time_work, working_hours, working_hours_ft) |>

    digits = list(everything() ~ 0),
    statistic = all_continuous() ~ "{median} [{p25}, {p75}]",

    ) |> 
  add_ci(method = list(all_categorical() ~ "svyprop",
                       all_continuous() ~ "svymedian.mean"),
         style_fun = list(all_categorical() ~ label_style_sigfig(digits = 0, scale = 100),
                          all_continuous() ~ label_style_sigfig(digits = 0))) |> 
  add_p(test = list(all_categorical() ~ "svy.adj.chisq.test",

  )
```

### Supplement-Figure 5B: Accepting patients by Canton

```{r}

data |> 
  filter(place_work == "Praxis (Grundversorgung oder Spezialist:in)" | place_work == "Sowohl Spital als auch Praxis") |>
  select(accepting_new_patients, canton_work) |> 
  tbl_summary(by=canton_work) |> 
  add_overall()


data_accepting_patients_canton <- data |>
  select(canton_work, accepting_new_patients) |>
  na.omit() |>
  mutate(accepting_new_patients = case_when(accepting_new_patients == "Ja, alle Kinder und Jugendlichen (0-16 Jahre)" ~ "Ja",
                                            accepting_new_patients == "Ja, aber nur bestimmte Gruppen (Aufnahmekriterien werden unten erfragt)" ~ "Bestimmte",
                                            TRUE ~ as.character(accepting_new_patients)
  )) |>
  group_by(canton_work, accepting_new_patients) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")


data_accepting_patients_canton <- data_accepting_patients_canton |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = accepting_new_patients,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = list(count = 0)
  )

data_accepting_patients_canton <- data_accepting_patients_canton |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    total_responses = sum(c_across(c(Ja, Nein, Bestimmte))),
    yes_proportion = Ja / total_responses,
    no_proportion = Nein / total_responses,
    selected_proportion = Bestimmte / total_responses,
    yes_selected_proportion = (Ja + Bestimmte) / total_responses
  ) |>
  ungroup()

data_accepting_patients_canton <- data_accepting_patients_canton |> 
  mutate(canton_work = case_when(canton_work == "Freiburg" ~ "Fribourg",
                                 canton_work == "Waadt" ~ "Vaud",
                                 canton_work == "Wallis" ~ "Valais",
                                 canton_work == "Neuenburg" ~ "Neuchâtel",
                                 canton_work == "Genf" ~ "Genève",
                                 TRUE ~ canton_work))

map_cantons_sf <- GetMap("kant.map") |> 
  st_as_sf()


lakes_sf <- GetMap("see1.map") |> 
  st_as_sf()


map_cantons_sf <- map_cantons_sf |>
  left_join(data_accepting_patients_canton, by = c("name" = "canton_work")) |> 
  bind_cols(st_coordinates(st_centroid(map_cantons_sf)))

plot_accepting_patients_cantons <- ggplot(data = map_cantons_sf) +
  geom_sf(data = lakes_sf, fill = "lightblue", color = NA )+
  geom_sf(aes(fill = yes_proportion), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_viridis(direction = 1, breaks = 0.25*0:4, labels = percent(0.25*0:4), limits = c(0,1), option = "magma")+
  geom_text_repel(mapping = aes(x = ifelse(name == "Basel-Stadt", X - 5000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Jura", X + 3000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Vaud", X - 5000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Fribourg", X + 5000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Aargau", X + 3000, X))))),
                                y = ifelse(name == "Basel-Stadt", Y + 8000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Vaud", Y + 2000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Fribourg", Y + 7000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Obwalden", Y - 2500,
                                    ifelse(name == "Zürich", Y + 2000,
                                    ifelse(name == "St. Gallen", Y - 3000, Y)))))), label = ifelse(is.na(yes_proportion), "NA", paste0(round(yes_proportion*100, 0), "%"))), bg.color = "black", bg.r = 0.1, size = ggtext_size(7), color = "white", force = 0.001, force_pull = 10000)+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(fill = "Pediatricians (%) accepting all new patients")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 7, colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 7, colour = "black"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(l=0, b=0, r=0, t=-0.5, unit = "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    plot.margin = margin(l=0, b=0, r=0, t=0, unit = "cm")) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5))


plot_accepting_patients_cantons

ggsave(filename=file.path(here("output","figures","plot_accepting_patients_cantons.svg")),plot_accepting_patients_cantons,device=svg,units="cm", height=20, width=18, bg = "white")


plot_accepting_all_some_patients_cantons <- ggplot(data = map_cantons_sf) +
  geom_sf(data = lakes_sf, fill = "lightblue", color = NA )+

plot_accepting_all_some_patients_cantons
```

## Agreement with factors (Lack of FTE pediatricians, Low number of patients per day and pediatrician)

```{r}

data_factors <- data |> 
  filter(place_work == "Praxis (Grundversorgung oder Spezialist:in)" | place_work == "Sowohl Spital als auch Praxis") |>
  select(record_id,
         fte_pediatric_primary_care_agreement,
         few_physicians_agreement, few_pediatric_training_agreement, few_assistant_physicians_pediatrics_agreement, few_pediatricians_primary_care_agreement, much_part_time_work_agreement,
         few_patients_per_day_agreement, much_time_consultation_patients_agreement,much_time_consultation_administration_agreement, time_lost_cancellation_agreement, time_lost_bagatelle_agreement, time_lost_parent_time_agreement, time_lost_language_agreement) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -record_id, names_to = "Factor", values_to = "Response") |>
  count(Factor, Response) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Response, values_from = n, values_fill = list(n = 0)) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(n_total = sum(Agree, Disagree, Neutral, `NA`),
         n_responded = n_total-`NA`,
         prop=Agree/n_responded,
         upper = Sprop(m = Agree, n = n_responded, N = n_pediatricians_practice_FMH)$ci$exact[2], 
         lower = Sprop(m = Agree, n = n_responded, N = n_pediatricians_practice_FMH)$ci$exact[1],
         lower = lower,
         upper = upper) |> 
  ungroup()

get_legend2 <- function(plot, legend = NULL) {
  if (is.ggplot(plot)) {
    gt <- ggplotGrob(plot)
  } else {
    if (is.grob(plot)) {
      gt <- plot
    } else {
      stop("Plot object is neither a ggplot nor a grob.")
    }
  }
  pattern <- "guide-box"
  if (!is.null(legend)) {
    pattern <- paste0(pattern, "-", legend)
  }
  indices <- grep(pattern, gt$layout$name)
  not_empty <- !vapply(
    gt$grobs[indices], 
    inherits, what = "zeroGrob", 
    FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
  )
  indices <- indices[not_empty]
  if (length(indices) > 0) {
    return(gt$grobs[[indices[1]]])
  }
  return(NULL)
}
```

```{r}
         few_patients_per_day_agreement, much_time_consultation_patients_agreement,much_time_consultation_administration_agreement, time_lost_cancellation_agreement, time_lost_bagatelle_agreement, time_lost_parent_time_agreement, time_lost_language_agreement) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -record_id, names_to = "Factor", values_to = "Response") |>
  count(Factor, Response) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Response, values_from = n, values_fill = list(n = 0)) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(n_total = sum(Agree, Disagree, Neutral, `NA`),
         n_responded = n_total-`NA`,
         prop=Agree/n_responded,
         upper = Sprop(m = Agree, n = n_responded, N = n_pediatricians_practice_FMH)$ci$exact[2], 
         lower = Sprop(m = Agree, n = n_responded, N = n_pediatricians_practice_FMH)$ci$exact[1],
         lower = lower,
         upper = upper) |> 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
get_legend2 <- function(a.gplot){
  if (!gtable::is.gtable(a.gplot))
    a.gplot <- ggplotGrob(a.gplot)
  leg <- which(sapply(a.gplot$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")
  a.gplot$grobs[[leg]]
}
```

```{r}

data |> 
  filter(place_work == "Praxis (Grundversorgung oder Spezialist:in)" | place_work == "Sowohl Spital als auch Praxis") |>
  select(motivation_factors_practice_missing) |> 
  tbl_summary(digits = list(everything() ~ 0))
  
data |>
  filter(motivation_factors_practice_missing == "Available") |> 
  select(motivation_factors_practice___1, motivation_factors_practice___2, motivation_factors_practice___3, motivation_factors_practice___4, motivation_factors_practice___5, motivation_factors_practice___6, motivation_factors_practice___7, motivation_factors_practice___8) |> 
  tbl_summary(digits = list(everything() ~ 0))


# 95% CI for motivation_factors
data |> 
  filter(motivation_factors_practice_missing == "Available") |>
  select(motivation_factors_practice___1) |>
  mutate(motivation_factors_practice___1 = case_when(motivation_factors_practice___1 == "Checked" ~ 1,
                                    TRUE ~ 0)) |> 
  pull() |> 
  Sprop(N = n_pediatricians_practice_FMH)

data |> 
  filter(motivation_factors_practice_missing == "Available") |>
```

```{r}
data_taxpunkt <- data_taxpunkt |>

plot_taxpunkte_cantons <- ggplot(data = map_cantons_sf) +
  geom_sf(data = lakes_sf, fill = "lightblue", color = NA )+
  geom_sf(aes(fill = taxpunkt_2024), color = "black")+
scale_fill_viridis(
    direction = 1,
    option = "mako",
    limits = c(0.8, 1.0),
    rescaler = function(x, to = c(0.25, 1), from = NULL) {
    scales::rescale(x, to = to, from = range(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  }) +
  geom_text_repel(mapping = aes(x = ifelse(name == "Basel-Stadt", X - 5000 ,
                                    ifelse(name == "Vaud", X - 15000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Fribourg", X + 4000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Aargau", X + 3000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Jura", X + 3000, X))))),
                                y = ifelse(name == "Basel-Stadt", Y + 8000 ,
                                    ifelse(name == "Obwalden", Y - 3000,
                                    ifelse(name == "St. Gallen", Y - 4000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Schaffhausen", Y + 2000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Fribourg", Y + 8000,
                                    ifelse(name == "Zürich", Y + 4000, Y)))))), label = format(round(taxpunkt_2024, 2),nsmall = 2)), bg.color = "black", bg.r = 0.1, size = ggtext_size(8), color = "white", force = 0.001, force_pull = 10000)+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(fill = "Tariff point values")+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 8, colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 8, colour = "black"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(l=0, b=0, r=0, t=-0.5, unit = "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    plot.margin = margin(l=0, b=0, r=0, t=0, unit = "cm")) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5))
```
