## Table 3: Linear regression


```{r}

data_single_practice <- data |> 
  select(canton_practice, practice_type) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  group_by(canton_practice) |> 
  summarise(n_pediatricians_single_practice = sum(practice_type == "Einzelpraxis", na.rm = TRUE),
            n_pediatricians_total = sum(is.na(practice_type)==FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(single_practice_proportion = n_pediatricians_single_practice/n_pediatricians_total,
         canton = canton_practice) |> 
  ungroup()

data_non_Swiss_trained <- data |> 
  select(canton_practice, country_medical_school) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  group_by(canton_practice) |> 
  summarise(n_pediatricians_non_Swiss_trained = sum(country_medical_school != "Schweiz", na.rm = TRUE),
            n_pediatricians_total = sum(is.na(country_medical_school)==FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(non_Swiss_trained_proportion = n_pediatricians_non_Swiss_trained/n_pediatricians_total,
         canton = canton_practice) |> 
  ungroup()

data_residency_practice <- data |> 
  select(canton_practice, practice_residency) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  group_by(canton_practice) |> 
  summarise(n_pediatricians_residency_practice = sum(practice_residency == "Ja", na.rm = TRUE),
            n_pediatricians_total = sum(is.na(practice_residency)==FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(residency_practice_proportion = n_pediatricians_residency_practice/n_pediatricians_total,
         canton = canton_practice) |> 
  ungroup()

model_data <- fte_mice |> 
  select(fte_per_1000_0_15, fte_per_1000_0_17, canton) |> 
  left_join(fte_canton_canton |> mutate(n_practice_pediatricians_per_1000_0_15 = n_practice_pediatricians_fte/total_population_0_15*1000,
                                        n_practice_pediatricians_per_1000_0_17 = n_practice_pediatricians_fte/total_population_0_17*1000) |> select(canton, mean_working_percentage, n_practice_pediatricians_per_1000_0_15, n_practice_pediatricians_per_1000_0_17, total_population_0_15, total_population_0_17), by = "canton") |> 
  left_join(data_FMH |> select(canton, n_total_pediatricians_FMH, n_total_doctors_FMH), by = "canton") |>
  mutate(n_total_pediatricians_per_1000_0_15 = n_total_pediatricians_FMH/total_population_0_15*1000,
         n_total_pediatricians_per_1000_0_17 = n_total_pediatricians_FMH/total_population_0_17*1000,
         n_total_doctors_per_1000_0_15 = n_total_doctors_FMH/total_population_0_15*1000,
         n_total_doctors_per_1000_0_17 = n_total_doctors_FMH/total_population_0_17*1000) |> 
  left_join(data_taxpunkt, by = "canton") |> 
  left_join(data_population_urban |> select(canton, urban_population_proportion_0_15, urban_population_proportion_0_17), by = "canton") |> 
  left_join(data_canton_bip |> select(canton, bip_per_capita), by = "canton") |> 
  left_join(data_canton_medical_diplomas |> select(canton, n_medical_diplomas_per_1000), by = "canton") |> 
  left_join(data_single_practice |> select(canton, single_practice_proportion), by = "canton") |> 
  left_join(data_non_Swiss_trained |> select(canton, non_Swiss_trained_proportion), by = "canton") |> 
  left_join(data_residency_practice |> select(canton, residency_practice_proportion), by = "canton") |> 
    left_join(data_shortage_canton |> 
              rename("canton" = "canton_work", "shortage_proportion" = "yes_proportion") |> select(canton, shortage_proportion)) |> 
  left_join(data_accepting_patients_canton |>
              rename("accepting_proportion" = "yes_proportion") |> select(accepting_proportion, canton_work), by = c("canton" = "canton_work")) |> 
  left_join(data_number_patients_canton |> 
              rename("canton" = "canton_work"), by = "canton") |> 
  filter(canton != "Schweiz") |> 
  mutate(urban_population_percentage_0_15 = urban_population_proportion_0_15*100,
         urban_population_percentage_0_17 = urban_population_proportion_0_17*100,
         single_practice_percentage = single_practice_proportion*100,
         non_Swiss_trained_percentage = non_Swiss_trained_proportion*100,
         residency_practice_percentage = residency_practice_proportion*100)
```

```{r}

model_data |> ggplot(aes(y = fte_per_1000_0_17, x = shortage_proportion)) +
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

model_data |> ggplot(aes(y = fte_per_1000_0_17, x = accepting_proportion)) +
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")


cor(model_data |> select(fte_per_1000_0_17, shortage_proportion, accepting_proportion, median_number_patients))

cor_with_ci <- function(data, method = "pearson") {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(data))
  
  # Variable names
  vars <- colnames(data)
  n <- length(vars)
  
  # Initialize matrices
  cor_matrix <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  p_matrix <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  lower_ci <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  upper_ci <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  
  # Loop over pairs
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in i:n) {
      x <- data[[i]]
      y <- data[[j]]
      
      complete <- complete.cases(x, y)
      x <- x[complete]
      y <- y[complete]
      
      if (length(x) > 2) {
        test <- cor.test(x, y, method = method)
        
        cor_matrix[i, j] <- cor_matrix[j, i] <- test$estimate
        p_matrix[i, j] <- p_matrix[j, i] <- test$p.value
        lower_ci[i, j] <- lower_ci[j, i] <- test$conf.int[1]
        upper_ci[i, j] <- upper_ci[j, i] <- test$conf.int[2]
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Add row/col names
  dimnames(cor_matrix) <- dimnames(p_matrix) <- 
    dimnames(lower_ci) <- dimnames(upper_ci) <- list(vars, vars)
  
  return(list(
    correlation = cor_matrix,
    p_value = p_matrix,
    ci_lower = lower_ci,
    ci_upper = upper_ci
  ))
}

cor_with_ci(model_data |> select(fte_per_1000_0_17, shortage_proportion, accepting_proportion, median_number_patients))
```
